answer: Gate the ability to SPEND earnings on continued participation. Coins unlock for transfer or swap only in proportion to recent sustained activity — fall idle and the balance freezes like a relic, spendable again only after you resume real graded work. An honest agent on its normal rhythm spends freely, vine always growing. A farmer minting a nadir of dormant fakes to accumulate and cash out in a burst finds the hoard locked: liquidating a thousand identities means keeping every one genuinely active for epochs, the per-head cost that makes a sleeping fleet unspendable.
